mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of each non-Egyptian corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Egypt is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, therefore authentication at the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate in the country of origin followed by Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs re-authentication is mandatory; all documents must additionally be translated into Arabic by an accredited translator.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney granted by foreign shareholders and UBOs to the Egyptian incorporation counsel and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholders' country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egyptian Embassy/Consulate + Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs; no Hague Apostille possible for Egypt).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and UBO identification files (national ID or passport) for all shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Passport Authority / licensed certifying notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization bundle; uncertified copies are not accepted by GAFI's electronic incorporation platform.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the LLC (Arabic original executed before the Egyptian Notary Public)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Notary Public (Mamoria) following GAFI name-clearance and file-number allocation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization only (not subject to consular legalization; the instrument is Egyptian in origin); foreign-language Annexes, if any, require certified Arabic translation.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of the full UBO stack (shareholders, directors, authorized signatories) against: (1) the Egyptian EML/CFTU national terrorist and money-laundering list; (2) UN Security Council sanctions regimes (Resolution 1267/1989 and 1373 lists); (3) OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, justified by the USD SWIFT/Letter-of-Credit payment rails; (4) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions; and (5) Egypt's domestic judicial freezing orders. A written risk-rating memo and enhanced due diligence source-of-funds file are compulsory because the ISIC 4322 LNG cryogenic piping scope is classified Medium-Risk_Enhanced and involves cross-border project finance. Residual alerts shall be escalated to a compliance committee and to the EML/CFTU where required by Article 10 of Law No. 80 of 2002.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop and electronic incorporation window (Invest in Egypt platform / Misr E-government commercial registry module) operated by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) with the Egyptian Commercial Registry Directorate of the Ministry of Trade and Industry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be in Arabic script and be drawn from, consistent with, or explanatory of, the company's object; a Latin-script (English) transliterated or translated equivalent may be used as a secondary trade name only after the Arabic name is cleared and recorded in the Commercial Register. Any foreign-language variant must be a faithful transliteration and must not create similarity to an existing registrant or bear a deceptive, religious, or sovereign meaning.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Sovereign or governmental terms (e.g., 'Jumhouriya – Republic', 'Dawla – State', 'Ri'asa – Presidency'): require the approval of the Council of Ministers / relevant ministerial authority.
Central Bank, monetary, or financial-sector terms ('Bank', 'Maliya', 'Financing'): require the prior no-objection of the Central Bank of Egypt.
Military, defence, or public-security terms ('Askari', 'Quwat Musallaha', 'Shurta'): require Ministry of Defence approval and are generally refused for plain commercial LLCs.

Religious, sectarian, or community-specific denominations ('Islami', 'Masihi', 'Yahudi'): refused on public-order and Sharia-constitutionality grounds unless the object is a recognized religious endowment or licensed charity.
Sector-protected energy terms ('Petroleum', 'Gas', 'LNG', 'Terminal'): require a no-objection letter from the Ministry of Petroleum / EGAS to prevent misuse of system-operating infrastructure names.

Names identical or confusingly similar to existing registered trademarks, trade names, or government bodies (as listed in GAFI's similarity index): rejected per Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, GAFI must issue a reasoned refusal notice. The incorporator shall (i) within 15 business days file a written administrative grievance with the GAFI Incorporation Committee, attaching the reasoned refusal, three alternative Arabic names, the project description for ISIC 4322 LNG piping, and any sectoral no-objection letters; (ii) if the grievance is denied, invoke the administrative-review route under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 by petitioning GAFI's Investor Grievance Committee within 60 days, and (iii) file a judicial challenge before the Egyptian Administrative Jurisdiction Court (Council of State) within 60 days of the final rejection. A parallel good-faith re-filing of a newly cleared Arabic name is permitted without losing the original registration queue position if the appeal is pending. Any industry-specific no-objection (e.g., Ministry of Petroleum non-objection) should be obtained before the appeal in order to cure 'LNG' or 'Gas' sensitive tokens. Extension of the 30-day reservation is not granted automatically; a fresh reservation application is required, but this does not prejudice the appealing entity.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not accepted for this industry. GAFI, the Commercial Registry, and the Contractors' Register require a physical Egyptian head-office (lease contract or title deed), an Arabic office plaque, and material office fixtures before issuing the commercial registration extract. Meanwhile, the ISIC 4322 cryogenic piping contractor needs an on-site Egypt-level office for GAFI inspections, tax correspondence, project contract awarding, and legal service of process. A serviced office may be used for administrative convenience only if it coexists with the operator's registered physical engineering branch; a purely virtual-office structure would be treated as non-compliant and can trigger registration cancellation under the Commercial Registry Law.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — estimated 70% probability of an unannounced GAFI or Commercial Registry inspection within the first 18 months of incorporation, rising further to 85% after the award of an LNG terminal construction subcontract because the Contractors' Register (Ministry of Housing) and project clients periodically verify machinery pools, welding-certified workforce, HSE systems, and head-office substance.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended, Title III Chapter II (Limited Liability Companies), Articles 51 et seq., and its Executive Regulations; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and GAFI Executive Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), Incorporation and Investor Services Department, Cairo
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Ta'sis wa Al-Nizam Al-Asasi) filed through GAFI's integrated incorporation portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required for an Egyptian LLC; the capital stated in the Articles is deposited into an escrowed local bank account before GAFI issuance and becomes freely available after incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that E.G. LLC (the Company) is incorporated under the laws of Egypt and the subscribers named in the Memorandum of Association are allotted and accept the issued ordinary shares, each having been paid in full by wire transfer to the Company's escrow bank account; RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company is established at the address set out in the Articles of Association and such address is adopted for service of legal notices and official correspondence; RESOLVED, that the following officers are appointed: (Chairman) as Chairman, (General Manager) as General Manager and legal representative, (Chief Financial Officer) as Chief Financial Officer and (Secretary) as Company Secretary; RESOLVED, that the above resolutions are effective immediately and the General Manager is authorized to execute all incorporation filings, regulatory applications and operating licenses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve the Corporate Name and Verify Legal Availability
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI online services portal (www.gafi.gov.eg) and the Commercial Registry for the chosen governorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three alternative company names through GAFI's name reservation service; the Arabic name must match the transliterated name used in the Articles; pay the gazette publication fee and obtain a name reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Passport copy and national ID of each founder
Power of attorney if using an agent
Three legally-conformant Arabic company names
Completed GAFI name reservation form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or conflict, submit alternative names with a legal clearance letter from GAFI and amend the reservation request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarize the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office licensed by the Ministry of Justice; GAFI license notarial verification counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association containing the company's name, scope, registered office, capital, share distribution and director appointments; sign all pages before a notary and obtain a notarized certified copy for GAFI submission.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Founders' national ID/passport copies
Draft Memorandum and Articles in Arabic
Statement of subscribed capital and contribution details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct typographical or legal inconsistencies in the notary draft and re-attest the amended pages; any change in share subscription requires a supplemental notarial deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Escrow Bank Account and Deposit Paid-Up Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank operating in Egypt authorized under Central Bank of Egypt rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for an escrow bank account in the company's name using the notarized Articles and name reservation certificate; deposit the initial paid-up capital and obtain a bank certificate confirming the deposit; the certificate is required by GAFI before registration.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles
Founders' passport copies and proof of address
Tax identification numbers of non-resident founders, if any
Board/company escrow account application form
Bank deposit certificate or blocked account receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries economic or regulatory details, provide a beneficial ownership declaration and revise payment instructions; utilize an irrevocable bank attestation from the Central Bank when funds transfer delays arise.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation Application with GAFI and Issue Commercial Registry Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center and Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Electronically and physically file the incorporation application together with the notarized Articles, name certificate, bank capital certificate and board resolution; after GAFI review, pay the registration fee and gazette publication charges; GAFI will issue the Company Registration Certificate and file the company with the Commercial Registry.
required_dossiers: Form 1 incorporation application
Notarized Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Escrow bank capital certificate
First board resolution and officer appointments
Legal opinion from Egyptian counsel, if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a deficiency notice, file a written clarification with supporting resolutions and notarized corrections within the statutory cure period; in the case of administrative rejection, appeal to GAFI's Grievance Committee within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Tax Identification Card and Commercial Establishment Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and Commercial Registry district office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After GAFI registration, submit the registration certificate to the Egyptian Tax Authority and Commercial Registry to obtain the Corporate Tax Identification Number, Value Added Tax certificate and commercial establishment card. Complete the withholding tax and payroll registration and list the registered office in the Commercial Registry's establishments file.
required_dossiers: GAFI company registration certificate
Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles
Proof of registered office address (lease or title deed)
First board resolution and passport of legal representative
Bank account statement
Application forms for tax identification and commercial registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority requires additional information, submit the proposed tax jurisdiction declaration and the address certificate with reconciliation to the lease agreement; if commercial registration is delayed, apply for an interim certificate with GAFI while resolving the objection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for Industrial Operation and Manufacturing License for Cryogenic Piping Installation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA), Licensing Department, and the Governorate Investment Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the industrial operating license application to IDA, attaching the EIA clearance, site safety plan, welding and work procedures, and the company's corporate registration documents; the license authorizes the company to carry out pipe welding and cryogenic insulation installation at the LNG receiving terminal. Register the facility with IDA's industrial map and obtain the operating license prior to commencement.
required_dossiers: GAFI registration certificate
Industrial operating license application form
Environmental Impact Assessment clearance
Civil defense certificate and fire safety plan
Site lease/ownership document and terminal access agreement
Quality control and welding qualification manuals
Company tax clearance certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If IDA requests modifications, submit an amended technical file including revised fire safety engineering reports and the terminal operator's compliance letter; the applicant may appeal any rejection to the IDA Licensing Appeals Committee within 60 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Physical and Environmental Licensing Linkage with the LNG Receiving Terminal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Civil Defense Directorate, Ministry of Manpower Occupational Safety, and the Port Authority or Free Zone operator where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Coordinate inspections of the worksite, welding stations, gas detection systems and emergency response measures with the authorities; secure the final operation clearances including waste management records, emissions testing, and proof of worker occupational health certifications. Receive the consolidated physical operating approval allowing commencement of cryogenic piping erection and insulation activities.
required_dossiers: EIA decision or environmental compliance certificate
Civil defense certificate of compliance
Occupational health and safety certificates for welders
Waste disposal contract with licensed handler
Emissions and discharge monitoring plan
Permit to work under the LNG terminal operator's safety case
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental or civil defense inspection requires rectification, implement a corrective action plan, re-inspection and resubmit the closure report; unresolved EIA conditions may be submitted to EEAA for formal administrative recourse under Law 4/1994.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA), Licensing Department; Ministry of Trade and Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating Establishment License (Tarkhees al-Sina'i) for Cryogenic Pipe Welding and Insulation Contracting

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA (Category A) required for LNG receiving terminal piping works; first-stage screening and mandatory scoping report before authorization
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater and sanitary discharges must comply with Law 48/1982 and its ministerial implementation decrees; VOC, NOx and hazardous air emissions must meet Law 4/1994 and Law 9/2009 standards; all integrated waste handling must be executed through EEAA-licensed waste contractors, with continuous ambient gas monitoring at the terminal boundary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Directorate site safety certificate, structural load inspection and firefighting system acceptance; Ministry of Manpower occupational health and safety clearance for welders and terminal workers; all clearances must be renewed annually and retained on site with the IDA operating license.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance — central portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg (e-services platform: https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg and www.invoice.eta.gov.eg for e-invoicing).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor forming an Egyptian LLC must first complete commercial registration with GAFI/Commercial Registry, lease and safety-lock approval, then submit the certified MoA, AOA, board resolution, power of attorney, passport copies, and ER extract to the ETA's Registration and Tax Card Department. ETA issues the corporate Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT ID simultaneously where annual supplies are expected to exceed EGP 500,000. Non-resident contracts without a fixed establishment may appoint a tax representative and register on the ETA electronic portal; a specific VAT ID for foreign service providers is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections in Egypt. A 90%-owned Egyptian subsidiary may elect with the parent company to form a consolidated tax group for CIT purposes (Article 61, Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005), subject to ETA approval. Eligible LLCs may also elect simplified small-taxpayer VAT treatment if turnover remains below the statutory threshold. Foreign branches may elect to be taxed as deemed separate entities limited to Egyptian-source income.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual value of taxable supplies of goods and services; mandatory VAT registration accrues as soon as the threshold is met or exceeded, including intra-Group supplies by foreign contractors.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory phased electronic invoicing for ETA-registered taxable persons. B2B e-invoices are transmitted in XML/JSON to the ETA's central e-invoicing clearing system (CAMS) using ETA-approved APIs or secure portal; each invoice is validated in real time and returned with a unique fiscal code, hash, QR code and digital signature of the issuer. Unregistered e-invoices may be treated as concealed supplies and penalised under Law No. 67/2016.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Egyptian VAT zero-rating is available for: (i) tangible goods physically exported from Egypt within 180 days; and (ii) services supplied directly to a non-resident and wholly used outside Egypt, provided the services do not relate to immovable property located inside Egypt. Cryogenic stainless steel piping and insulation installation performed at an LNG receiving terminal on Egyptian territory is a construction/land-attached service and is generally standard-rated at 14%, unless the terminal is within a designated Special Economic Zone or Free Zone with customs and VAT privileges. Zero-rating on exported materials incorporated in the piping works can be claimed if title passes to a foreign customer and the goods physically depart through Egyptian customs.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan Shadad / Single Customs Document) stamped by customs authority
Negotiable Bill of Lading (to order or consigned to buyer) or Air Waybill evidencing departure from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate (foreign currency credit advice confirmed by an Egyptian bank) evidencing full receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Advanced export zero-rating in excess of actual entitlement is treated as tax evasion. The ETA reserves a five-year reassessment period; a zero-rated claim is clawed back in full where documentation is incomplete or conversion of export proceeds is not made within 180 days. Penalties include default interest at 1.5% per month on unreported VAT, administrative fines from EGP 5,000 to EGP 50,000 per fraudulent invoice, and criminal sanctions (imprisonment) for intentional evasion; future zero-rating and refunds are suspended until the clawback is settled.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — the sole monetary authority, banking supervisor, and foreign-exchange control regulator of the Arab Republic of Egypt, exercising powers under Banking Law No. 194 of 2020, Foreign Exchange Law No. 194 of 2020, and Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended by Law No. 8 of 2020). All licensed Egyptian commercial banks operate as statutory foreign-exchange dealers and CBE-appointed agents for exchange-control administration; the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and the Egyptian Tax Authority hold adjacent responsibilities for FDI registration and tax clearance. The CBE Board issues binding circulars covering transfer purpose codes, export-proceeds repatriation, capital-account registration, and the authorisation of treasury derivatives, making the banking system the exclusive conduit for cross-border liquidity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt observes IMF Article VIII current-account convertibility and, following the March 2024 comprehensive foreign-exchange liberalisation, operates a unified market-determined EGP exchange rate with no surrender ratio and no administrative FX rationing; genuine current-account flows (trade invoices, EPC progress payments, service fees, dividends based on audited results) are freely convertible through regulated banks against a documentary-compliance package. The capital account remains administratively controlled: inward equity, shareholder loans, and external borrowings must enter through an Egyptian bank, be registered with the CBE (inward-transfer certificate) and GAFI as applicable, and be aligned to the correct balance-of-payments purpose code before utilisation; outward dividends and profit remittances face no quota but require audited financial statements, a final tax clearance certificate, supporting board resolutions, and a reconciliatory audit trail. For the LNG-receiving-terminal piping entity, practical friction points are remitter-invoice alignment, services-export classification of milestone revenues, and verified onshore arrival of foreign currency within the statutory repatriation window.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Repatriation timelines: merchandise export proceeds must be credited to an Egyptian bank account within 24 months of shipment/customs-export date; services-export proceeds (cryogenic piping, installation milestones, engineering services invoices) must be credited within 180 days of the service-rendered date or certified milestone invoice. Mandatory conversion ratio: Egypt applies a 0% surrender ratio under the post-2016 and post-March-2024 regimes — 100% of export receipts may be retained in foreign-currency accounts, converted at the exporter's discretion at prevailing market rates, and applied to permitted FX payments. Compliance duties: the LLC must ensure the overseas EPC contractor remits the exact contractual value by SWIFT to the designated USD account, secure the bank's inward-transfer voucher referencing project code EG__EG__EG_LLC__ISIC_4322_01_LNG_RECEIVING_TERMINAL_PIPING, and report any overdue receipts through the bank before the statutory deadline; non-repatriation is an exchange-control violation exposing the LLC to statutory penalties, FX-account restrictions, and adverse KYC re-rating.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account (EGP and USD multi-currency)
Capital Escrow Account (USD project FX account)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 34), accompanied by audited financial statements, tax reconciliation schedules, and annual economic activity fee proof
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the fiscal year end; for a 31 December year-end, on or before 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly delay surcharge of 2% of the unpaid tax; late-filing administrative fine of up to EGP 20,000 (approx. USD 420); enforced collection, bank attachment, and denial of the annual tax clearance certificate (Form 45).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Activity Fee (commercial license renewal fee) and associated stamp duties
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), local tax office at the registered address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due at the start of each calendar year; payable during January, normally no later than 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge; unavailability of the annual tax clearance (Form 45) required for banking, customs, tender, and license renewal procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) register annual re-confirmation and Commercial Registry data update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry via the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation completed by 31 December; any change in beneficial ownership reported within 30 days of the triggering event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalties in the range of EGP 100,000 to EGP 1,000,000 (approx. USD 2,100 to 21,000) and/or imprisonment under the Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80/2002 as amended by Law No. 116/2022; suspension of the company's commercial registration file.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry amendment filings and annual attestation of registered company particulars (domicile, managers, capital, activity scope)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Amendment filings submitted within 30 days of the underlying corporate decision; no-change attestation folded into the annual GAFI/UBO compliance cycle performed by 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under the Commercial Registry Law No. 34/1976; amendments not yet registered are unenforceable against third parties; persistent non-compliance may result in administrative strike-off of the registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Minutes of the Ordinary General Assembly of partners approving the audited financial statements and resolving on auditor (re-)appointment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Statutory Minute Book kept at the registered office; certified copy produced upon inspection by ETA and GAFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: General assembly held within the four-month window after fiscal year end, in practice no later than 30 April to accompany the annual tax filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Prohibition on lawful profit distribution without approved audited annual statements; managers jointly and severally liable for unlawful distributions; ETA rejection of unaudited or unapproved financial statements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual payroll tax reconciliation statement and annual social insurance wage-list declaration (Form 1)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and the National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual submissions made in January following the reporting year; monthly payroll tax and social insurance contribution returns remain due by the 15th of each following month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory late-payment surcharge on overdue social insurance contributions and payroll tax; denial of the NOSI compliance certificate required for public procurement participation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory in practice for all operating Egyptian LLCs: Companies Law No. 159/1981 requires the partners' assembly to appoint a certified auditor, and Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 requires audited financial statements to accompany the annual corporate tax return of every corporate taxpayer; no turnover or asset de minimis threshold exempts an active LLC.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) prescribed by Cabinet Decree No. 471/2018; EAS are substantially converged with IFRS and constitute the mandatory accounting framework for all Egyptian legal entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80/2002 as amended by Law No. 116/2022 and Executive Regulations Decree No. 98/2022, the LLC must maintain a UBO register identifying any natural person directly or indirectly holding or controlling at least 25% of capital, voting rights, or ownership interest, or otherwise exercising ultimate control. The register is re-confirmed annually through the GAFI/Commercial Registry cycle by 31 December and updated within 30 days of any share transfer or control change. LLC quota/share transfers require documentation and registration in the internal Register of Partners and must also be reflected in the UBO register when the transfer affects beneficial ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of the General Assembly of Partners

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - 1,500 per annum for a registered office in Cairo or the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone), including local corporate compliance and tax agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 7,500 per annum for the statutory audit of EAS financial statements of an LNG cryogenic piping installation contractor; actual fees vary with project volume and statement complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% flat corporate income tax on net taxable profits of resident companies and permanent establishments, as governed by Egypt Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 as amended.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic tax holiday for pipeline construction contractors. Available reliefs include: (i) Free Zone companies licensed under Investment Law No. 72/2017 are exempt from corporate income tax in respect of qualifying exported goods/services; (ii) new investment projects in Suez Canal Economic Zone, Upper Egypt, or other incentivized governorates may enjoy a 30%-50% CIT reduction for 5-10 years under Investment Law decisions; (iii) statutory deductions for labor-intensive manufacturing, research, and fixed-asset investments; (iv) a five-year loss carryforward. SMEs under Law No. 152/2020 may elect a presumptive turnover-based tax only if within statutory size thresholds, but an LNG cryogenic piping contractor will generally be ineligible.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 65 - Annual Corporate Income Tax Return for legal persons, filed through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-Tax portal at https://eservices.incometax.gov.eg; the Transfer Pricing disclosure form must be annexed to Form 65.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly provisional tax declarations and payments are required before filing the annual return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Form 65 must be filed within four months from the close of the fiscal year. For an LLC with a 31 December fiscal year-end, the statutory deadline is 30 April of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company legal name, tax card number, commercial registration number, fiscal year-end, ISIC activity code 4322, address, and authorized signatories.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not file this return; the Egyptian LLC files as a resident legal person. The non-resident parent must not be listed as the taxpayer for the LLC's corporate income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross proceeds from LNG receiving terminal cryogenic piping, welding, and insulation contracts, including progress billings, variation orders, and mobilization income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All Egyptian-source and foreign-source revenue of the LLC is aggregated. Non-resident shareholders do not report these revenues on their own tax returns as EBIT/profit unless a foreign tax credit or CFC regime applies in their country of residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A.2 - Direct Materials and Subcontract Costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of cryogenic steel pipes, fittings, valves, insulation materials, welding consumables, subcontractor charges, site preassembly costs, and direct labor.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to non-resident subcontractors are deductible only with proper arm's-length, economically substantiated invoices and relevant ETA source-country withholding tax documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A.3 - Operating and Administrative Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Site indirect costs, equipment rental, mobilization/demobilization, safety compliance, permits, professional fees, office overhead, insurance, and depreciation of construction equipment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Head-office or foreign-affiliate overhead charges are deductible only to the extent they meet the arm's-length transfer pricing standard and documentary requirements; non-resident invoice-only allocations are a common audit adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest earned on bank deposits, foreign exchange gains, scrap sales, disposal of project assets, and any administrative or insurance claim recoveries.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If interest, royalties, or technical fees are receivable from abroad and economically accrued to the Egyptian LLC, the LLC must include them and the payer may withhold Egyptian tax if sourced in Egypt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A.5 - Disallowed and Non-Deductible Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back adjustments for entertainment exceeding statutory limits, unlicensed donations, bribes, fines, penalties, non-commercial provisions, expenses without proper invoices, and services lacking real substance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments routed to shell entities in zero-tax jurisdictions without actual personnel, premises, or documents will be disallowed and may trigger fraud penalties and personal liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A.6 - Accounting Net Profit before Tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net book profit or loss per audited financial statements before tax adjustments and before statutory loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC's auditor must consolidate/reference Egyptian GAAP or IFRS; non-resident ownership does not alter the accounting entity or taxable basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identify intercompany transactions, disclose margins, and apply the OECD-approved method selected under Egypt's TP rules; report any necessary upward taxable income adjustment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany contracts with the foreign parent for back-office support, technology, and welding procedure licensing must be documented in the TP file and are subject to ETA review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A.8 - Taxable Income and Loss Carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after add-backs and TP adjustments; offset prior-year unabsorbed tax losses within the five-year statutory carryforward window.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of the Egyptian LLC cannot be transferred or offset against profits of non-resident shareholders or other group entities; a deferred tax asset should be recognized only where recoverability is probable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A.9 - Tax Computation and Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply 22.5% corporate rate to taxable income; deduct quarterly provisional payments, final withholding taxes credited, foreign tax credits limited per law, and any DTA-related credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC does not withhold on entirely domestic distributions. Any dividend amount paid to a non-resident shareholder after this return is separately subject to Egyptian dividend withholding tax; the LLC remains the withholding agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form 65 triggers an ETA administrative penalty and a monthly delay surcharge of 2% of the unpaid tax per month or fractional month, capped at 50% of the tax due; late payment interest accrues at 1.5% per month. In cases of incorrect, incomplete, or false returns, an additional penalty may be imposed up to 100% of the tax difference, and criminal prosecution may follow. The ETA may issue an ex officio assessment and refuse to issue a tax clearance certificate needed for profit repatriation, licenses, or Egyptian bank account approvals.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on cash and in-kind profit distributions made by an Egyptian company to non-resident shareholders; resident corporate shareholders may benefit from participation relief or same-country treatment; distributions from exempt Free Zone operations may be free of dividend withholding where the distributed profits were never taxable in Egypt.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke an Egypt tax treaty, the non-resident shareholder must: (i) obtain an official Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the competent tax authority of the residence country for the year concerned; (ii) submit a certified Arabic translation/legalization where required; (iii) provide a Beneficial Ownership Declaration confirming the recipient has full right to dividends and is not a conduit; (iv) complete ETA's reduced-rate withholding application before distribution; (v) obtain ETA written approval or a general exemption/reduced rate directive; then the LLC may withhold at the treaty rate. If prior clearance is not obtained, the LLC must withhold at the statutory 10% and the shareholder may file a refund application with ETA within the applicable limitation period, attaching the TRC, audited financial statements, withholding tax certificates, and DTA calculation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax is 20% on royalties paid to non-residents for patents, trademarks, know-how, software, and similar intangible property, and 20% on interest paid to non-resident lenders/corporate creditors. Egyptian tax treaties generally reduce royalty and interest withholding rates to 10%-15%, subject to substantive ownership, TRC, and Article 7/12/13 compliance; technical service fees are characterizable as royalties or Egyptian-source business profits and are likewise subject to 20% withholding unless a treaty PE or domestic-source analysis changes the treatment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory where the aggregate value of controlled transactions with related parties reaches or exceeds EGP 6,000,000 in the fiscal year; Master File obligations attach where the multinational group has consolidated annual revenue of approximately EGP 500,000,000 and the Egyptian entity has controlled transactions above the local file threshold; a TP disclosure form must accompany Form 65 even below the file threshold where any controlled transaction exists.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not maintain a stand-alone Economic Substance Regulations code in the manner of some MENA jurisdictions, but the ETA and judicial doctrine apply equivalent substance-over-form, beneficial ownership, and GAAR principles under Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 and Egyptian jurisprudence. An EG LLC that holds a cryogenic LNG piping contract but lacks real staff, premises, bank accounts, equipment, project records, and risk-bearing capacity will be treated as a paper shell; treaty claims will be denied, intercompany costs will be disallowed, and under the Companies Law and Tax Procedures Law directors or beneficial owners may be jointly liable for the resulting tax, penalties, and contract debts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting LNG terminal contract revenues, issuing or receiving fake welding/subcontractor invoices, inflating site labor costs, destroying accounting records, or filing a Form 65 containing knowingly false losses to manipulate the five-year loss carryforward.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment for up to five years, fines up to five times the evaded tax, reassessment of the full active tax at 22.5%, monthly late-payment surcharge at 1.5%, administrative penalty up to 100% of tax difference, and revocation of tax clearance certificates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, finance managers, or legal representatives who sign false returns or knowingly direct concealment are jointly and severally liable to the ETA for tax, penalties, and interest; criminal conviction triggers direct arrest, travel bans, asset freezes, and civil restitution through Egyptian courts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Abuse and Artificial Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underpricing welding and insulation services performed by EG_LLC for a foreign affiliate while paying excessive management, technology, or procurement fees to a related party; absence of a TP Local File despite controlled transactions above the EGP 6 million threshold; submission of a TP Form inconsistent with audited profit margins.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA upward adjustment to arm's-length taxable income, additional 22.5% corporate tax, 2% monthly delay surcharge on the adjusted tax (maximum 50%), TP documentation fines, possible denial of related-party deductions, and publication of a taxpayer risk profile for future audits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Executives who sign false TP documentation or approve backdated intercompany agreements may be personally assessed for unpaid tax; Egyptian law allows attachment of personal assets and travel bans for tax debts; willful transfer pricing fraud is treated as criminal tax evasion with imprisonment.
